import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")


# Clean the Comment field - remove surrounding quotes and normalize whitespace
def clean_comment(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = text.strip()
    # Remove any leading/trailing double quotes
    text = text.strip('"').strip()
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text


train_df["Comment_clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)
test_df["Comment_clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_comment)

# Create feature matrix
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 5), max_features=20000)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["Comment_clean"])
y_train = train_df["Insult"]

X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment_clean"])

# Stratified split for validation (ensure 80/20)
X_train_fold, X_val, y_train_fold, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Random Forest Classifier
rf_clf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=None,
    min_samples_leaf=1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)
rf_clf.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold)

# Generate validation probabilities and compute AUC-ROC
y_val_proba = rf_clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
validation_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_proba)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {validation_auc}")

# Generate test predictions
y_test_proba = rf_clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission dataframe with required format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"probability": y_test_proba})

# Save to required path
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
